entries.sequence: VALUE | ARTICLE.NONE* | ADVERB.COMPARISON.SUBTRACTION | PREPOSITION.CONJOINMENT.COMPARATIVE | VERB.COMPARATIVE | PREPOSITION.CONJOINMENT.SUBJECTIVE | VALUE

entries.sequence: VALUE | ARTICLE.NONE* | ADVERB.COMPARISON.MULTIPLICATION | PREPOSITION.CONJOINMENT.COMPARATIVE | VERB.COMPARATIVE | PREPOSITION.CONJOINMENT.SUBJECTIVE | VALUE

entries.name: IO.Print
entries.effect: Writes the selected typed rendering and appends LF; no L return value is declared.

entries.name: IO.Output
entries.effect: Obtains the standard-output handle; does not lock, write or flush.

entries.name: IO.Diagnostic
entries.effect: Obtains the standard-error handle; does not redirect Print.

entries.name: IO.Send
entries.effect: Writes the borrowed byte view and returns std::io::Result<()>; no added LF, lock, flush or panic.

entries.name: IO.Lined
entries.effect: After payload success, sends LF through the same writer; returns the first error or unit success.

entries.name: IO.Flush
entries.effect: Requests an explicit native writer flush and returns its IO Result.

notes: The cases enumerate recognizers, including categories whose general executable construction is not established. Consult each type’s support boundary before using a configured value pattern.
References preserve canonical declaration/member identity. A reference must resolve in its owning scope. The value category independently determines permitted use.
Recognizes a Text token. Ordinary source Text and typed scalar/native-byte emission are implemented. Preserve literal bytes and distinguish framing escapes from general string escapes.
Recognizes a binary64 Number token, not a %-delimited source literal. Range, finite-value and native encoding boundaries remain stage-specific.
Recognizes a Truth token loaded from lowercase true/false. This pattern does not introduce ?-delimited source literals or implicit truthiness.
Explicit Null initializes an absence value. Show renders null. It is distinct from an unassigned slot and internal None/Unknown states.
Matches the native type token category. Construction and usable values depend on the explicit source type whitelist, descriptor binding and selected category.

Typed owned Lists construct, append, replace and read indexed values. Heterogeneous construction infers Thing without coercion. Indices and complete element types are checked. Iteration/removal remain outside this API.
Recognizes Dictionary type/storage structure. Namespace members and imports are demonstrated. Arbitrary runtime map operations are not thereby supported.
A subject participates in declaration/binding and paragraph antecedent selection. Its cases distinguish declared names, resolved references and definitions.
A quoted declaration plus typed declarative phrase. Native whitelist and construction rules determine the represented category.
A named List requires an explicit runtime constructor for initialization. Typed elements and checked operations follow the List contract.
A quoted Dictionary declaration provides owned namespace/storage. Generic runtime map operations remain outside the established surface.
A quoted name and definitive declarative phrase participate in typed registration/construction.
A quoted name with a definitional Text phrase must satisfy paired framing and typed definition parsing.
A quoted name and value phrase retain the concrete value category and assignment/definite-assignment boundaries.
A quoted name may carry an optional phrase. Registration ownership and context determine whether that site is a usable declaration.
A resolved identifier preserves its selected owner and canonical declaration. It is not a fresh declaration.
A #~# type token selects a native category rather than a quoted source identifier. Its supported role depends on the enclosing grammar.
A resolved definition and generic phrase preserve source ownership, bound parameters and permitted composition.
A quoted action label followed by a for/directive body records ordered source actions and typed any-parameters.
A quoted label with a to/utilization phrase defines native text or a supported action relation. It is not an import provider phrase.
An encapsulated paragraph begins with the ordinary Function declaration and owns its body. Public visibility exposes the Function, not its parameters.
A quoted parameter name is paired with a complete runtime type or an existing callable signature.
A Text name precedes a resolved nominal definition and optional relations. Naming alone does not establish a constructor for every internal value tag.
A Text name precedes a recognized native type and optional relations. The explicit native type and descriptor contracts determine supported construction.
A quoted identifier occurs as an owned declaration/reference role. It is not a Text literal or a universal executable scalar value.
A named reference carries a dependency phrase. Supported Use import scanning and source-provider ownership remain authoritative. Arbitrary grammar placement does not imply import execution.
An atomic operand leaves its destination phrase for the enclosing update clause. Its resolved runtime type still governs use.

A checked callable construction can carry explicit constructor operands before its signature, or a structured Process input signature and directive body. Canonical targets determine the native constructor and scoped binding roles.
This phrase associates grammatical objects, prepositions or clauses as given by its sequence. Its location and optional/repeated terms are defined by the configured matcher, not conventional EBNF.
This phrase participates in construction or argument attachment. Native placeholders have explicit type and encoding contracts. Do not infer arbitrary coercions.

The for phrase contains ordered applicative clauses. Source actions retain their generic argument and recursion checks. Structured Process inputs and locals bind within that body while retaining enclosing Function references. This adds no general loop syntax.
Recognizes List construction arguments. The List contract defines typed elements, checked updates, indexed reads and bounds errors. This recognizer adds no general source loop syntax.
The phrase owns a declaration object whose scope and publication are resolved semantically.
The as phrase supplies a bound value. Concrete type and runtime assignment requirements remain enforced.
The body is a typed Text object with explicit framing/escaping at the definition boundary.
A declarative alias phrase must resolve its target and preserve canonical ownership. It does not copy an application or widen visibility.
Declares an ordinary Function with its signature.
Pairs a named parameter with a complete runtime type or existing Function signature.
Supplies a Number index for Lists/Bytes or a Text key for Map reads and writes. Runtime checks reject invalid keys and bounds.
Selects the source of a typed read, with an optional indexed key. Complete requested runtime type identities are checked before extraction.
Selects a typed update destination and optional index or field key. Runtime mutation does not change vocabulary namespaces.
Configured in/collection relation. The retained grammar does not establish general executable insertion, indexing, or dictionary mutation.
Consumes the destination and its complete Number/Text key phrase. An at keyword without a key is not an update.
The to phrase supplies an imperative source clause or Text body to a definition. It is distinct from Use/import dependency resolution.
The to phrase contains an imperative clause. Enclosing definition semantics determine how it is used, distinct from dependency imports.
The to phrase contains a Text object. Native definition framing and typed argument encoding, not an import path, determine its meaning.
Source-provider ownership governs relative imports and expanded declarations. Grammatical dependency attachment does not override those ownership rules.
Assignment follows resolved typed-storage rules and definite assignment. Runtime ordering is preserved independently of parser retry order.
Generic clauses call source-defined vocabulary with resolved typed arguments. Runtime captures use retained typed environments. Asynchronous methods are not introduced.
A Function declaration defines an ordinary invocation verb. Its sentence binds ordered typed arguments and explicit result names. Member ownership selects the declaration.
The source-defined action signature and canonical binding determine the subject/object arguments and their order. Native definition slot kinds are a separate interface.

Grammar selects a declared passive form of the already resolved canonical word, including identical root/passive spellings. Source actions retain their selected definitions. General passive Function-call signatures are unsupported and reject without dropping operands.
A declaration associates a source name with the indicated category or value. Voice-specific recognizers do not imply interchangeable native behavior.
Create a typed ordinary Function at an encapsulated paragraph boundary. Each declaration activation owns its capture environment.
Definition clauses establish source vocabulary or typed native-backed forms. Accepted construction and framing are bounded by definition expansion.
Descriptive clauses apply source-defined adjective/adverb meanings. Constructor descriptors preserve the target and source-unit ownership.
Put/Place resolve typed runtime updates. Keys, element/field types and ownership cycles are checked. This recognizer does not add iteration or removal.

Passive Put uses its grammatical subject as the value and the existing List/Map phrase as the destination and key. It reuses checked update lowering. Pointer passive syntax and additional collection operations are not introduced.
Use the documented Put/Place and typed-read operations. These outer collection forms add no removal or iteration. Recognizing a grammatical form does not establish another operation API.
Association names an existing canonical value or definition. It does not create an independent runtime copy.
Build is the runtime readiness operation. It is distinct from the CLI command that compiles native output.
Run launches the selected process. The grammar does not imply that every applicative category is runnable.
Await joins a selected process invocation and activates its continuation once. A parsed clause alone does not establish valid activation placement.
Stop requests termination without joining. Final output still requires the Await contract.
Import/Export-style configured vocabulary is not a native outer instruction. The supported Use dictionary/source import path is documented separately.
Show emits the resolved operand without Print’s added newline; Output reads are subject to process finalization.
Exit ends the compiled program. Function-local Return uses the selected Function.Return definition and checked outputs.
Scalar conditions have specific type constraints. Joined conditions are rejected by outer lowering. No general short-circuit Boolean expression language is established.
A bare condition requires one Truth operand. Optional negation belongs to this condition, with no scalar truthiness or joined-condition contract.
Has is bounded to the selected App Error member and must retain matching target ownership.
The exact configured phrase maps to a typed scalar operator. Equality requires matching scalar types. Order requires Number. Native operator witnesses do not independently verify every source phrase.

While has configured vocabulary and a conditional grammar rule, but the documented illustration currently fails grammar processing. Outer instruction lowering also has no While operation. Rust backend iteration cases do not establish source-language loop support.
This wrapper selects a clause or conditional family. Complete statements must consume their associated tokens. A named alternative is not proof of native operational support.

Function signatures declare ordered named inputs and result types, or explicit No Inputs/No Outputs. Structured Process bodies accept typed input bindings without callable outputs. Nested runtime and callable identities remain complete.

Input-only Process signatures bind pattern or iteration values within their directive body. Provisional labels cannot shadow enclosing inputs before their owner is resolved. Native selection/pair, mixed-nesting and scope-escape/output rejection witnesses constrain support. No general closure or Process output signature is added.
Invocation words bind ordered values and prepositional arguments. Argument counts and complete types are checked.
An invocation declares one result name per output, assigned only after the invocation completes.

Paragraph antecedents and declared source-action arguments resolve through source identity. A new paragraph lacking an antecedent is an enforced scope rule, not an unimplemented pronoun capability. Plural inflections retain the same configured lexical identity.
Input metadata covers Function parameters and scoped structured Process bindings. No App process input transport is supplied.
Native process operations and implicit Output/Error require an App. Source-defined actions and explicit members retain lexical precedence.
Dictionary owns lexical members, exports and canonical alias identity. It is a source namespace, not runtime key/value storage. Use Map for that distinct meaning.
Null initializes an explicit absence value. Typed reads preserve evaluation and type/index/key checks. Unassigned storage and the native-definition Null atom remain separate.
Explicit Thing boundaries retain concrete runtime types. Typed reads validate full element types and callable signatures. No implicit coercion or dynamic arithmetic.

Raw byte Text construction, literal binding, transfer and output implement the documented meaning. Lack of Unicode normalization or a general string-processing library is an API boundary, not an incomplete Text type.
Number is explicitly finite binary64. Parsing, native encoding and typed runtime use implement that meaning. Arbitrary precision and integer-width arithmetic are not promised.
The configured Byte/Bytes family is recognized, but only Bytes has owned storage. Singular Byte has no scalar source type or one-byte constructor. Octet reads produce Number.
Truth maps to bool and retains exact typed values. Absence of truthiness and limits on joined condition grammar do not make the value type partial.

Managed typed handles share targets. Reads snapshot ordinary contents. Checked mutation rejects ownership cycles, including container and callable-environment edges. No pointer arithmetic or raw-address API.

Configured native representation spelling, not a public application constructor or alias for the source Function, Property or Operation category. Its configuration handler is not executable API evidence.
Framed definitions attach to words and composed Functions. The recognized Definition category has no standalone New Definition source constructor for a runtime value to store or inspect.
Recognized applicational category and internal Function/Object attributes are implemented. No standalone New Attribute source data-field or runtime-value constructor is supplied.
Object constructs source-file content containing Functions and their definitions. Runtime initialization/lifetime is not part of the documented meaning.
Class constructs ordered module/source groups including nested Classes and Objects. It does not promise a runtime scope or instance lifetime.

Service declarations remain structural. Standalone bodies, packages and native process operations are unsupported. App-constructed Service libraries retain their workspace topology. Static inspection. Witnesses not run.
App construction preserves source graph identity and yields the executable/lifecycle boundary documented by this word. Apps are distinct from structural Services.

Assignment and same-type scalar equality/inequality are implemented. Definite assignment and rejection of mixed or non-scalar comparisons enforce the documented meaning rather than mark it unfinished.

One selected registry and source provider implement indexed imports, confined includes and canonical aliases. Unsupported provider names/remote package resolution are outside the explicit-source contract.
Registration constructs the named supported value/action with atomic declaration ownership and source identity. Arbitrary English or unspecified native constructors are not promised.
Registration binds supported values or explicitly framed typed native definitions, checking slots and lexical ownership. It does not bypass the declared type or visibility rules.
Descriptor construction binds canonical targets and ordered refinements, applies exact target rules and rejects mismatches/cycles. Aliases preserve identity while foreign homonyms remain distinct.
Typed updates append/replace List elements, write Map values or replace a Pointer target. Destination kind, keys, element types and managed ownership cycles are checked.

The configured receptive root parses but has no native instruction role or bound implementation. A public Compile probe of Get 0 from items rejects with unsupported outer instruction action action.receptive. The matched typed read control compiles.

The configured reductive root has no native instruction role or bound implementation. A public Compile probe of Take 0 from items reaches unsupported outer instruction action action.reductive. This is known unavailability, not unresolved semantics.
The configured inflective action is not the source loader. A public Compile probe of Import `io` rejects with unsupported outer instruction action action.inflective while Use IO from `io` compiles.

The configured deflective action has no lowering implementation. A public Compile probe of Export `io` rejects with unsupported outer instruction action action.deflective. Public/Publicly publish declarations. They are not runtime Export aliases.
The outer instruction uses the selected runtime-value display path, preserving raw Text and adding no LF. Direct App/Error display is outside the declared supported-value domain.
The outer instruction terminates the program and owns shutdown/cleanup even from a continuation or source action. Function.Return is deliberately separate. No unawaited continuation is promised.
Has tests the selected App Error, including same-App ownership. General collection membership is a different, unclaimed operation.
Equality of matching Text, Number and Truth operands is implemented. No coercion or arbitrary object equality is promised.
The declaration modifier publishes one canonical declaration without publishing siblings or cloning dictionary membership. Private captures and definite assignment retain their own checks.
Construction selects the declared noun and exact descriptor refinements with checked operands. There is intentionally no universal constructor, cloning fallback or invented initialization.

Native source constructors accept explicit ordered parameter atoms through their declared slots. GenericTypes and Lifetimes retain their approved local native-input contract. This does not infer parameters or introduce general L generics.
The publication adverb applies to the selected declaration, retaining its identity and defining paragraph. It is a distinct lexical role from Public, with the same checked publication mechanism.

Condition-owned negation is implemented by instructionCondition.Negated and native condition emission. Lack of joined conditions is an And/Or/If limitation, not a missing unary negation implementation.
Numeric strict and inclusive comparison are implemented. Rejecting Text ordering is the declared Number-operand contract.
And then preserves composed action order. Source-action expansion evaluates each complete body before the next coordinated operand. It is a sequencing token, not an asynchronous scheduling feature.
Declaration construction, aliases, typed parameters and invocation result names use the selected owning grammar and canonical binding. No standalone conversion operation is claimed.
Element types/contents and Function signature components are implemented through owner-specific construction and signature extraction.
Checked reads and updates bind Number indices or Text keys and retain the selected container and result types. Key and bounds checks are intended behavior.
Function signatures and descriptor-associated child constructions use With under their selected owners. It does not erase argument or descriptor contracts.
List/Map/Pointer update destinations are lowered and type checked. In has no unclaimed lexical-namespace behavior.

Generic Function argument phrases accept Out and bind an ordinary argument. The configured consignment.deflective role has no dedicated grammar phrase or executable deflective/output/export operation. Accepting a PREPOSITION in a generic call does not implement that missing role.

Generic Function argument phrases accept By and bind an ordinary argument. The configured phrase.indicative describes by Actor but no enclosing clause references that phrase to implement actor/passive execution. Generic separator acceptance does not implement that missing role.
Indexed/file import sources and checked typed-read sources are implemented by their distinct owners. Provider isolation and read typing are enforced contracts.

Native definition utilization, Function prepositional arguments and inclusive comparison phrases have their documented owner-specific implementations. To has no independent conversion/callback meaning.
Than supplies the comparison relationship in implemented numeric strict and inclusive conditions. Matching Number typing is intentional.
For introduces the source-action body. Source instructions expand the selected action with scoped arguments in declared order. It does not introduce a general loop construct.

Any introduces typed source-action parameters or exact descriptor targets. Canonical target checking and rejection of ambiguous antecedents implement its contract, without unrestricted native generic promises.
Explicit empty Function Inputs/Outputs and grammar-owned condition negation are implemented. No does not supply implicit initialization.
A/An indefinite article family participates in implemented declarations, constructions and Error conditions. It need not select a type independently of its noun.
The selects a definite subject/value in its existing lexical context. App body effects and member Function invocations have maintained witnesses. Visibility rejection is the contract.
Operand/declaration/action coordination works, but recognized And-joined conditions are explicitly rejected by instructionBuilder.conditional because no Boolean join operator is implemented.
Canonical descriptor target alternatives work, but recognized Or-joined conditions are explicitly rejected by instructionBuilder.conditional because no Boolean join operator is implemented.
Single typed conditions produce branches with flow checks. Recognized joined conditions reject during instruction lowering and configured else-if continuation rejects during grammar processing.
Plain Else works, but the configured conditional.else.if continuation does not parse as an executable chain. Actual valid single-if/else control passes while else-if leaves unassociated else tokens.

Otherwise attaches to the immediately preceding unmatched conditional within the same paragraph. Intervening instructions or paragraph boundaries correctly reject. They are ownership rules rather than missing support.

The configured While loop has no outer instruction implementation: instructionBuilder.statement accepts only if/else/other. The documented While fragment additionally fails grammar processing. Do not claim this fixture reaches lowering or that every possible configured While spelling was probed.
Build and publish. Accepts one optional source, defaulting to main.l.
Complete replacement filesystem. FlagSet also accepts single-hyphen and equals-value spellings.
Publish executable and companion output together, relative to the caller CWD.
Select source lexicon. The bundled default is eng. Explicit empty values fail.
Standalone --version/-v prints the embedded version and newline without compiler initialization.
Sole top-level help or command help before the source filename.
Supported help alias.
End flag parsing, including before a filename beginning with a dash.
The -os option is currently rejected.

Analysis commands remain offline. Explicit evidence capture performs bounded installed-tool observations. One required input follows options. No Cargo build, publication, or App execution in the contracts command group.
Inspection may succeed with unresolved obligations. It does not establish every reported property.

Requires --profile or --request-file. Checks the whole entry by default or exact published scopes in explicit requests. Contradicted or unresolved controlling obligations return 1 without semantic fallback.
An occurrence or source-byte selector is required. If no binding matches, the command returns 2.
Defaults to implementation assurance for the entire dictionary. Loading definitions is not certification.
Select text or JSON display. The default is text. Other values reject.
Writes the display to a distinct destination outside selected inputs and protected assets. Paths are resolved from the working directory.
Writes structured JSON. Both file destinations are validated together against selected source and metadata inputs.
One complete resource filesystem. Missing optional metadata has no embedded fallback.
Select source resources. The default is eng. An explicit empty value rejects.
Repeatable explicit manifests contribute records. Conflicts reject rather than override by order.
Explicit trust_policy document. Declarations do not approve themselves and default native approval is empty.
Repeatable supported whole-entry profiles. Check requires these or --request-file. PreservesOnFailure requires an explicit request footprint. Whole-entry profiles reject in symbolic assurance mode.
Required for explain. Matches exact occurrence identity or origin.source:origin.start.
Repeatable, nonempty canonical rule meaning or declaration source-byte selector. Applies only to dictionaries and must resolve uniquely.
Implementation is default. Symbolic requires explicit adjective selection and excludes whole-entry profiles. Success leaves native assurance separate.
Group help accepts --help/-h. Subcommand FlagSet help is available before input. Displays usage with status 0.
End subcommand option parsing, including before an input beginning with a dash.

Version 2 build evidence binds the recorded inputs, companion placement, Cargo invocation and artifact digests to the same compilation. Required evidence is written before executable publication. Failed Cargo invocations remain recorded. Custom asset providers pass source/AML freshness checking before native build staging. Offline inspection does not recompose resources.
Capture explicit, bounded, offline installed-tool resolution/version observations. The command requires --output. It performs no build, fetch, publication, App execution or native approval.
Checks version 1 captures or version 2 build records against current inputs and dependencies. Offline inspection reconstructs companion placement in memory and executes no historical commands.

Check-only versioned requests select whole_entry or exact published scopes. PreservesOnFailure requires a supported observation, nonempty exact resource footprint and failure outcomes. Every controlling obligation remains in the report.
Capture-only compatibility assertion. It must match the observed native host triple. It does not enable cross-compilation.
Owned byte sequences construct from Text, snapshot and support checked indexed reads as Number. Byte mutation and numeric-width families are not supplied.

Functions bind typed invocation verbs and private bodies. Signatures include canonical constructor identity. Aliases preserve it and incompatible transfers reject. Emission uses selected builtin/logeme definitions. The callable type and builtin composition use the same selected Function constructor. Canonical word prose is associated explicitly rather than duplicated.

Descriptors retain canonical targets through aliases and qualified imports. Source nouns bind typed formals and fixed operands to selected constructors. Replacements consume original operands. Wrappers name and preserve the base result. Operands evaluate once in authored order. Native moves and borrows remain checked. This is not a resource-cost certificate.

Configured visibility, negation, comparison and progression roles work. General application of a newly authored Adverb body to an action is not implemented. Lexical recognition does not establish that capability.
Internal representation tag. Source constructors, typed storage and ownership are implemented separately from raw primitive/native-definition encoding.
Internal tag. Source construction and runtime support are documented separately.

Ordered source operations use the shared instruction path. Provisional input labels acquire their actual Process scope before semantic use and cannot shadow enclosing Function parameters or escape into siblings. Explicit annotations preserve declared types and dependencies for native type and borrow checking. No callable outputs or closure runtime are added.
The canonical Function definition supplies composed signatures and Process bodies for source declarations and constructed Objects.

Root-authored returning actions use their caller’s selected Return. Its implementation keeps lexical delegates; Function-owned Returns retain their constructor contract and reject incompatible callers. Known unconditional source-actor and transparent-Process exits terminate typed caller flow. Real Function calls, conditional and opaque bodies retain their own boundaries and native obligations.

Core Retain consumes a borrowed Arc and returns another handle to the same allocation without cloning its payload. The App source wrapper delegates to core Retain without lifecycle effects. Storage.Retain remains Rc-based. Atomic ownership does not certify payload Send/Sync or destructor costs.
Source-defined Service/Object/Function construction descriptor used by Apps. It grants no standalone Service process role.

Typed updates append/replace List elements, write Map values or replace a Pointer target. Destination kind, keys, element types and managed ownership cycles are checked. Passive Put uses the same checked List/Map update with its subject as the value. Pointer updates remain imperative; unsupported callable passive signatures reject.
Reviewed registered export namespace for dictionary language=eng key=io. Index-driven addition/rename/deletion must trigger new review.

Print retains Render then private Write. Write obtains one stdout guard, invokes the source Lined Sender and applies shared Result.Expect with the existing failure message. Bytes, formatting and LF policy remain unchanged.
One selected std::io::stdout call. Resource identity does not establish authority or isolation.
One selected std::io::stderr call. It supplies an alternate native writer handle without adding an input or networking API.

The source Function composes a borrowed byte view with write_all. Its native operation handles short writes and Interrupted, and rejects zero progress with WriteZero. L adds no extra retry policy. A failure can follow partial output. Allocation and blocking remain native obligations.

Targets the actual derived Sender. Its private L-authored helper selects the retained Result. Base evaluation, generic arguments, result binding and helper provenance are preserved. It adds no output transaction or lifecycle operation.
One Write::flush call. Flushing may block or fail and does not establish durable storage.
Render, Write, Lock, byte view and line-completion source helpers remain private dependencies. Stream, Check and Slice have no compatibility aliases. Public byte IO is classified separately.
Groups inventoried grammar/vocabulary entries. Linked prose and implementation define support. Recognition alone does not establish execution.

Put/Place lower to checked runtime updates. Typed constructor reads supply indexed access. Get/Take, general source loop syntax and general removal remain unsupported. Storage traversal inside native Functions is a separate source composition.

The unnamed zero value is a compiler sentinel. It is not one of the 23 named representation tags or a public source constructor. valueTypeCount is an enum bound, not a stored value. Static inspection only.
Owned typed values keyed by Text bytes. Insertion/replacement and checked reads preserve complete element types and deterministic byte ordering. Distinct from a vocabulary Dictionary.
Internal representation tag. Executable source semantics are defined by the linked runtime type contract.
Error values can be constructed, stored, captured and placed in typed containers. App Error is optional until inspected. Extracting an absent Error rejects. Direct Show remains unsupported.

Activation-specific environments snapshot ordinary captures and retain shared Pointer targets. Actual arguments evaluate once in caller scope before callee entry. Copies retain environments until last-owner release. App-process capture transport is not inferred.

Explicitly importable implementation vocabulary, not implicit builtin or ordinary application vocabulary. Source compositions own typed traversal, result binding, lazy failures, release sequencing, byte appends and caller returns. Native allocation, blocking and destructor costs remain separate obligations.

Source implementation vocabulary selected through canonical dependencies. This is distinct from public application vocabulary. Runtime privately imports canonical Storage leaves and the shared Formatting implementation. Native host/platform inputs and generated composition retain separate ownership.

IO and Runtime select one canonical Formatting Function. Shared bindings, control and numeric operators use Storage. Private Integer/Wide/Indexed/Unsigned preserve their nominal targets and compose through Storage.Cast without intermediate narrowing. No Numeric dictionary or implicit arithmetic vocabulary is added. Formatting and IO do not source-load process supervision.
Selected Function invocation uses resolved native target and ordered argument atoms. Callers normally use their Function invocation verb.
Selected native entry delegation receives a compiler-resolved reference and is the sole entry tail call. Quoted Text is not a native target-reference API.
Dictionary namespace for native Option operations. This is not an L runtime carrier type.
Dictionary namespace for native Result operations. Native payload and error types remain explicit.
Evaluate the supplied Option once. Choose a typed Some Process or payload-free None Process without cloning.
Evaluate the supplied Result once. Choose a typed Ok or Err Process within the enclosing Function.
Consume Option<T> and &str. Preserve success payload or construct runtime failure only for None. Argument evaluation remains ordinary.
Consume a native Option or Result and an eagerly evaluated &str message. Preserve the payload or panic using the native expect policy.

CV constructs one unscheduled future. Local Capture selects Infer or Move. DV awaits one native or composed operand in async context. CO/COB bind one value. Rust enforces ownership and typing. This adds no async-FW modifier or Function dispatcher.
